annotations.description: GPU VRAM utilization is at {{ $value }}%. Only a small fraction of the 24GB remains available.
GDDR6X memory temperature. GDDR6X throttles at 110C; sustained 95C+ means the thermal pads need replacing. Source: gpu-vram-temps.timer (dcgm-exporter does not expose this field).
GPU core at or past the 83C throttle point. Expect clock loss and reduced tokens/sec.
GPU hotspot/junction temperature sustained above 100C. Check pump, mounting pressure and airflow.
GPU reported an XID error - a hardware or driver fault, not a load issue. Check: dmesg | grep -i xid
GPU drawing above the configured 270W cap. Check: systemctl status nvidia-power-limit.service
gpu-vram-temps.timer has not produced a reading in 5 minutes. Junction and VRAM alerts are blind while this fires.
dcgm-exporter is down. Every GPU temperature and VRAM alert is blind while this fires.
llama-swap is not responding; Open WebUI will fail every request.
node-exporter is down. No host CPU, RAM, disk or per-CCD temperature data.
UPS is not on mains power (2 = onLine). Begin a graceful shutdown before the battery runs out.
UPS battery status not normal (2 = normal). Check for a failed or ageing battery pack.
UPS above 75% of rated capacity. Lower POWER_LIMIT_W or move load off this UPS.
UPS has under 5 minutes of runtime remaining (value is TimeTicks/6000). Shut down now.
GPU core sustained above 80C. The 3090 throttles near 83C; check case airflow and fan curves. Covers both cards - the previous rule watched only gpu 1.

Ryzen 9 5950X Tdie sustained above 85C (sensor high limit is 95C). Was set to 70C, which this CPU exceeds under any sustained load. Per-die detail: temp3=Tccd1 is the inference die, temp4=Tccd2 the RAG/database die.

A Ryzen CCD sustained above 85C (Tdie sensor high limit is 95C). The die label says which: CCD0-inference runs the llama-swap cores 0-4, CCD1-rag runs Postgres, Qdrant and the embedding stack on cores 8-15.

The two CCDs differ by more than 25C averaged over an hour. A steady ~11C gap is normal on this machine (measured: Tccd1 26.3C avg, Tccd2 37.9C avg at idle), so a much larger one points at cooler mounting, pump flow or a badly skewed workload rather than a hot die. Averaged because the raw Zen 3 CCD sensors swing several degrees at idle.
Host RAM above 85% of 64GB for 5 minutes. Model weights live in VRAM, so sustained host pressure usually means the RAG stack on CCD1 - Qdrant, Postgres, Tika - rather than inference.
